decisions.reason: The plugin was only recently launched and publicly listed, maintenance costs are low, and the firm's commitment to its e-commerce plugin line makes early withdrawal unlikely.
The ERP interface took substantial integration effort, ties clients into the firm's ecosystem, and is central to its announced direction, so management will persist despite limited evidence.
Price comparison tracking is core to the firm's market research positioning, and any weak uptake can still be blamed on the short time on the market.
This is one of several overlapping tracking plugins, which raises some risk of consolidation, but sunk development costs and public listing favor keeping it for now.
Its overlap with the other tracking plugins makes it the most likely candidate for pruning, but commitment to the announced product family should keep it on the market another year.
The reporting plugin complements the net price display plugin within the same publicly committed line, and its low marginal cost supports persistence.
